checks.expected_result: Hien tai quan sat thay (BASELINE, lần khảo sát): Import 1 file Excel HOP LE (dung header template, du SKU/Color/Size/Price) tra HTTP 500 {message:'Server Error'} - lap lai 2/2 lan voi 2 cach tao file khac nhau (workbook moi vs sua truc tiep tren file template cua server), loai tru nguyen nhan do dinh dang phia client. Import file THIEU SKU tra loi RO RANG va DUNG: 'SKU is required in row 2'. 'Delete selected' (chon 1 variant qua click so thu tu dong, bam nut) thuc hien XOA NGAY qua GET deletion-check (200) + DELETE (204), KHONG co dialog xac nhan nao truoc do. Day la baseline hien tai, KHONG phai hanh vi mong doi da duoc PO/dev xac nhan - PO chi cho phep 'cu run' tren store test/staging, khong assert ket qua cu the. Cau hoi loi HTTP 500 co phai bug can fix khong duoc tach thanh check rieng CHK-05-014 (P1).

checks.title: Duong UI thuc su de gan Custom Printareas rieng cho tung variant: click 1 lan SAU KHI bat toggle - DA TIM DUOC (CONFIRMED, supersede KB-046)
checks.precondition: Da bat toggle 'Custom variant's printarea' (dieu kien TIEN QUYET bat buoc - xem reconcile_note)
steps: Bat toggle 'Custom variant's printarea'
Click (1 lan, khong can double-click) vao o 'Custom Printareas' cua 1 variant
Quan sat popup checkbox danh sach Printarea cua product hien ra
checks.observation_point: Su xuat hien cua popup checkbox sau 1 click vao o 'Custom Printareas'
checks.expected_result: CONFIRMED_EXPECTED (PO xac nhan 'trong variant grid co cot Custom printareas, click vao o do o tung variant thi se hien ra danh sach printarea de chon', 2026-09-13 ): SAU KHI bat toggle 'Custom variant's printarea', click (1 lan, khong can double-click) vao o 'Custom Printareas' cua 1 variant se mo popup checkbox danh sach Printarea cua product de chon/bo chon rieng cho variant do. Duong UI nay TON TAI va HOAT DONG dung. SUPERSEDE KB-046 (v1): finding cu 'chua tim duoc' la vi KHONG bat toggle 'Custom variant's printarea' TRUOC khi thu click (thieu tien dieu kien trong test cu), KHONG phai hanh vi he thong thay doi giua 2 lần khảo sát. KB-046 da duoc danh dau stale trong KB v2. GHI CHU GOP (round 2 rework, finding F-07, 2026-09-14): check nay truoc day co ban song song CHK-05-010 tham chieu cung KB-080 va cung ket luan - context-quality-reviewer round 2 xac nhan day la trung lap ngu nghia thuc su (khong phai boundary/goc do khac), nen CHK-05-010 da duoc GOP vao day va xoa khoi checklist (da gop o vong review thu 2). CHK-05-010 con co 3 buoc dieu tra rieng (double-click, nhan Enter, hover tooltip cua toggle) nhung KHONG co expected_result/oracle tuong ung nen KHONG duoc gop vao day duoi nhan STRONG - xem risk_refs de biet gap con lai.
risk_refs: FEAT-05 unknown_areas: duong UI gan Custom Printareas (DA TIM DUOC, dong gap)

Coverage gap con lai tu CHK-05-010 da gop (round 2, F-07): phan ung khi double-click/nhan Enter tren o 'Custom Printareas', va noi dung tooltip cua toggle 'Custom variant's printarea', CHUA co oracle/ket luan xac nhan - neu can kiem tra, phai tao check moi voi expected_result + kb_id ro rang, khong duoc gan oracle_strength STRONG/BASELINE thua ke tu check nay.
